text: Hey, what's up?
zh: 嘿，有什么事？

text: Advisor Edmon told me to get my equipment.
zh: 顾问埃德蒙让我来领装备。

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: Show me your wares.
zh: 让我看看你的货。

text: What do you know about this key?
zh: 你了解这把钥匙吗？

text: Marvin dealt with fake wine.
zh: 马文在倒卖假酒。

text: What can you tell me about the bandits?
zh: 关于那些强盗，你知道些什么？

text: I found this bag of the raider chief.
zh: 我找到了掠夺者首领的这个袋子。

text: What do you know about this list? (Cedric's Customer List)
zh: 你了解这份名单吗？（塞德里克的客户名单）

text: Cedric's list of customers was stolen by the Guard.
zh: 塞德里克的客户名单是被卫队的人偷的。

text: I want to train.
zh: 我想接受训练。

text: See you!
zh: 回头见！

text:
Sure!
I already received a notice about a new one.
zh:
没问题！
我已经接到通知，说要来个新人了。

text: Take this armor of a Royal Guard and be proud of it.
zh: 拿好这套皇家卫队的护甲，好好珍惜这份荣耀。

text: If you are in need of a new weapon, speak to Kolfinn, the smith here in the capital.
zh: 要是你需要新武器，就去找科尔芬，他是王都这里的铁匠。

text: I am #:Hick:#, the quartermaster of the Royal Guards.
zh: 我是#:希克:#，皇家卫队的军需官。

text: Let me see.
zh: 让我看看。

text:
Where did you get that key from?
This is the key to the basement of our barracks.
zh:
你从哪儿弄来的这把钥匙？
这是我们兵营地下室的钥匙。

text: Usually, it's only given to the quartermaster or royal guards who need to regularly check the #:king's crypt:#.
zh: 通常只有军需官，或是需要定期查看#:王室墓穴:#的皇家卫兵才能拿到它。

text: I should confiscate this key, but I will turn a blind eye this time.
zh: 按理我该没收这把钥匙，但这次我就睁一只眼闭一只眼吧。

text: For the king!
zh: 为了国王！

text:
He did what?!
Is he out of mind?
zh:
他干了什么？！
他疯了吗？

text:
He was in charge of the latest deliveries for Baron Frestek.
This certainly won't reflect well on our relationship with the Baron.
zh:
弗雷斯泰克男爵最近几批货都是他负责送的。
这下我们和男爵的关系肯定要受影响了。

text:
Holy crap!
How do I explain this to my boss?
zh:
见鬼！
我该怎么跟上头交代？

text: I know very little about the bandits themselves. I'm actually only here in the barracks and never outside the city gate.
zh: 强盗本身的事我知道得很少。我其实一直待在兵营里，从没出过城门。

text: Everything I know comes from the guards when they bring me the bandits' junk.
zh: 我知道的一切都来自卫兵们——他们会把强盗的破烂玩意儿送来给我。

text: What do the guards bring you?
zh: 卫兵们都给你送些什么？

text:
Mostly junk like rings or amulets.
Sometimes there are notes or documents among them that I'm supposed to bring to the king immediately.
zh:
大多是戒指、护符之类的破烂。
有时里面会夹着字条或文件，那些我得立刻呈给国王。

text: Why should you bring the documents to the king?
zh: 为什么要把文件呈给国王？

text: I'm not sure. I think he's probably trying to find out information about the bandits.
zh: 我说不准。我猜他大概是想打探强盗的情报。

text: But that is only a guess.
zh: 不过这只是猜测。

text:
This key leads to the basement of the barracks.
From there, you can access the #:Royal Crypt:# if you have work downstairs.
zh:
这把钥匙通往兵营的地下室。
要是你在下面有差事，可以从那里进入#:王室墓穴:#。

text:
From the raider chief?
Let me take a look.
zh:
掠夺者首领的？
让我看看。

text: Hmm... A few rings, gems, a rusty dagger...
zh: 唔……几枚戒指、几颗宝石、一把生锈的匕首……

text:
What is that?
It looks like a scroll.
zh:
那是什么？
看着像一卷卷轴。

text: Surely, the king wants to see that.
zh: 国王肯定想看看这个。

text:
Thank you!
That was a good find.
zh:
谢谢你！
这可是个好收获。

text: Here's your reward.
zh: 这是你的报酬。

text: I've got a decent handle on spears and rapiers.
zh: 长矛和刺剑我都使得不错。

text: But as long as you're not one of us, I'm not allowed to teach you anything.
zh: 但只要你还不是我们的人，我就不能教你任何东西。

text: So, what do you want to train with?
zh: 那么，你想练什么？

text: Spear weapon training (min. 5 STR, min. 3 DEX) [2 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_spear_weapon_training_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 长矛武器训练（需力量5、敏捷3）[2 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_spear_weapon_training_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: Rapier weapon training (min. 8 DEX) [2 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_rapier_weapon_training_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 刺剑武器训练（需敏捷8）[2 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_rapier_weapon_training_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: As guards, we must know how to fight.
zh: 身为卫兵，我们必须懂得战斗。

text: A spear isn't just a pointed stick. Think of it more as an extension of your arm.
zh: 长矛可不只是根带尖的棍子。把它当作你手臂的延伸。

text: Keep your enemies at a distance. If they get too close, you're in for a bad time.
zh: 让敌人保持距离。一旦他们贴得太近，你就有苦头吃了。

text: Rapiers and daggers give you speed and flexibility. Most of the time, a quick dodge will get you out of tight situations.
zh: 刺剑和匕首能给你速度与灵活。大多数时候，一个快速闪避就能让你脱离险境。

text: They won't stagger your foes, but overwhelm them with relentless and precise thrusts.
zh: 它们虽打不出让敌人踉跄的重击，却能用绵密而精准的刺击压垮对手。

text: Alternatively, I can sell you a few things, too.
zh: 另外，我也可以卖你一些东西。

text: Sure! Here's everything you'll need.
zh: 没问题！你需要的都在这儿了。

text:
A list?
Let me see...
zh:
名单？
让我看看……

text:
Where did you find the list?
Cedric, a mage of the academy, will not approve of you walking around with this list of customers.
zh:
你在哪儿找到这份名单的？
学院的法师塞德里克可不会乐意看到你拿着他的客户名单到处走。

text:
What?!
Return it to the academy immediately. It must have been misplaced during one of the recent deliveries.
zh:
什么？！
赶紧把它还给学院。肯定是最近某次送货时弄丢的。

text: I found it here in the cellar.
zh: 我就是在这儿的地窖里找到的。

text:
Here you have it back.
I hope this incident won't affect the next wine deliveries.
zh:
这个还你。
希望这件事不会影响接下来的葡萄酒配送。

text:
The list was stolen?
By a royal guard?!
zh:
名单是被偷的？
还是被皇家卫兵偷的？！

text: Those are serious accusations!
zh: 这些指控可不轻！

text: Still, it would explain why the list ended up in the barracks cellar.
zh: 不过，这倒能解释名单为何会出现在兵营的地窖里。

text:
Hold on!
Marvin was responsible for Baron Frestek's last wine deliveries.
zh:
等等！
弗雷斯泰克男爵最近几批酒就是马文负责送的。

text:
That worthless little...
Speak with him! You'll usually find him hanging around outside the barracks.
zh:
这个没出息的小……
去找他谈谈！他通常就在兵营外面晃悠。

text: What makes you think the Royal Guard is involved?
zh: 你凭什么认为皇家卫队牵涉其中？

text: What?! I can't believe that!
zh: 什么？！我不敢相信！

text: I found it here in the cellar.
zh: 我就是在这儿的地窖里找到的。

text: The list is probably related to the fake wine.
zh: 这份名单多半和假酒有关。

text:
What?!
What are you talking about?
zh:
什么？！
你在说什么？

text: Do you think a member of the Guard stole the list?
zh: 你认为是卫队的人偷了名单？

text: The mages think the forger has the list.
zh: 法师们认为名单在造假者手里。

text: No.
zh: 不。

text: Good. Return the list now, so you don't cause yourself any trouble.
zh: 那就好。现在把名单还回去，免得给自己惹麻烦。

text:
Shit!
So that makes us the prime suspects.
zh:
该死！
这么一来我们就成了头号嫌犯。
